fusions.name: Cavalry Fangs
fusions.desc: A galloping bite that deals 30 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. When it lands, every ally near you deals 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Kicked Up
fusions.desc: Kicks out at every enemy within 2.5 tiles for 4 damage. Its damage rises 5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 30%).

fusions.name: Breakaway Gallop
fusions.desc: Carries you 5 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds afterward.

fusions.name: Hoofbeat Heart
fusions.desc: You move 12% faster and have 8% physical resistance.
